material_findings.title: Independent TypeScript fence indexes lose same-physical-source payload evidence
material_findings.trace: A type-only ts public-api fence prints throw/FENCE_I1/ verbatim; a second ts public-api fence in the same Markdown supplies that literal through WorkerSource to new Worker with eval:true, but has a separate SourceFile/literal set.
material_findings.expected: Parallel program literal representation UNKNOWN/opaque with digest, length, source, owner and requirement retained

material_findings.title: Direct executable-source arguments are absent from initializer-only mirror evidence
material_findings.trace: In one TS source, export type SourceMirror = 'throw/INLINE_I1/'; followed by new Worker('throw/INLINE_I1/', {eval:true}); supplies no initializer/export-assignment root for that payload. The type printer retains its exact bytes.
material_findings.expected: Same-source explicit program-payload dual UNKNOWN/opaque in parallel type representation; no spelling blacklist
